why: The last move onto step n is either a 1-step from n-1 or a 2-step from n-2, so ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2): the base 1-D DP (Fibonacci) the week opens with.
hints: Think about the very last move you make to reach step n. Where could you have been just before it?
ways(n) = ways(n-1) + ways(n-2), with ways(0) = 1 (the empty climb) and ways(1) = 1.
Iterate from the bottom keeping only the last two values. O(n) time, O(1) space.
pitfalls: Plain recursion without memoisation is exponential and times out near n = 45.
Get the base cases right: ways(1) = 1, ways(2) = 2.
